title.zh: 即将进行的试点：物流重构

texts.zh:
各种货物的运输路线是我们贸易联邦兴旺繁荣的生命线。但迄今为止，各帝国仍在容器设计、装载程序及运输管道等方面采用各自的物流标准。

为了使效率最大化，一个新的试点项目将在几年后实施——项目目标是调研并试验一种全新、具体，适用于联邦所有成员国的运输标准。

参与试点需要拥有一个至少有50点贸易额流经的恒星系。此外，设有外星贸易公司意味着更高的统计数据，所以应对其进行鼓励。

由于项目所涉范围广泛，一些开销必不可少。但这些牺牲是为了长远的利益。换句话说，也就是更多的未来利润。

联邦各成员国均被强烈鼓励参与项目。
texts.en:
The routing of various goods is the life-blood of our prosperous trade federation. But so far each empire has relied on their own logistic standards with regards to container design, loading procedures, and shipping pipelines.

In order to maximize efficiency, a new trial project will commence in a few years - one that aims to investigate and trial a new, specific shipping standard that would be applied to all members of the federation.

Participation requires a system with at least 50 Trade flowing through it. Furthermore, the existence of an Offworld Trading Company would mean increased statistical data, and so is encouraged.

Due to the vast scope of this project, some costs will apply. But it's for the greater good. That is to say: more future profit.

Every member of the federation is strongly encouraged to participate.

texts.zh:
物流重构试点已经启动！多亏了我们帝国兴旺的贸易路线，[From.GetName]已获准参与试点项目！一处恒星基地已被挑出，用作试验站点，现在我们需要指派一艘工程船，以实施实际的重构项目。时间也是一个因素，所以不要再作犹豫。

我们还拥有一处外星贸易公司设施，正因如此，项目进度有所加快。公司所属的帝国将获得一些金融优待，以表感激。
texts.en:
The logistical remodelling trial has begun! Thanks to the empire's vigorous trade routes, [From.GetName] has been granted participation in the trial project! One starbase has been singled out as a test site, and now a Construction Ship must be assigned to perform the actual remodelling project. Time is a factor, so do not linger in this endeavour.

An Offworld Trading Company facility is also available, and thanks to this, the project will be expedited. The empire will be granted some financial leniency as a token of gratitude.

texts.zh:
物流重构试点已经启动！多亏了我们帝国兴旺的贸易路线，[From.GetName]已获准参与试点项目！一处恒星基地已被挑出，用作试验站点，现在我们需要指派一艘工程船，以实施实际的重构项目。时间也是一个因素，所以不要再作犹豫。

我们没有外星贸易公司。这不会阻止我们参与试点，但会在一定程度上妨碍项目进度，因为我们无法与所涉各方分享有价值的信息，以便充分对其进行利用。
texts.en:
The logistical remodelling trial has begun! Thanks to the empire's vigorous trade routes, [From.GetName] has been granted participation in the trial project! One starbase has been singled out as a test site, and now a Construction Ship must be assigned to perform the actual remodelling project. Time is a factor, so do not linger in this endeavour.

An Offworld Trading Company facility was not available. This doesn't stop our participation, but will impede progress somewhat as we cannot take full advantage of beneficial information-sharing between involved parties.

texts.zh:
为了对全新的物流标准进行试点，这一恒星基地的相关设施需要进行重大的结构性改造。多亏了本地的外星贸易公司，项目会进行的更为高效。

指派一艘工程船到这个项目，确保项目按时完成！
texts.en:
In order to try out the new logistical standards, the relevant facilities on this starbase need to undergo some major structural alterations. Thanks to the local Offworld Trading Company this project will be more efficient.

Assign a Construction Ship to the project, and make sure it's done on time!

texts.zh:
恭喜！重构操作已经结束，专用的贸易中心正按照全新的物流标准运行。除了对这一恒星系进行评估之外，没什么需要做的了。

在试验期结束时，关于试点项目结果的官方声明将会发布。
texts.en:
Congratulations! The remodelling operation has finished and the dedicated Trade Hub is now operating to a new logistical standard. Nothing left to do now but to evaluate the new system.

At the end of the trial period there will be an official statement on how the trial project turned out.

texts.zh:
这是就贸易与利润而言意义深远的一天！不仅物流试点成功完成，其结果更是表明星际商业往来更为顺畅，贸易效率显著提升！

结果是，联邦内一切太空贸易操作均会逐步地、不知不觉地切换到新标准进行；整个联邦将由此极大受益。

为利润而欢呼吧！
texts.en:
This is a monumental day for profit and trade! Not only is the logistics trial complete, but the results show a noticeable increase in efficiency and smooth interstellar business!

As a result, all space trading operations in the federation will now progressively - and quite unnoticeably - switch over to the new standard; the federation will benefit tremendously.

Hurrah for profit!

texts.zh:
这是就贸易与商业而言伟大的一天。试验期已经结束，项目已得到完全评估。我们收集到足够的数据表明贸易效率有所提升，应当全面实施新的物流标准。

现在开始，一切运输操作将逐步切换到新标准——但这个过程是完全自动的。食品会被递送，消费品会被送到它们的目的地，香料仍在运输，如此这般。

总之，干得漂亮！
texts.en:
It's a great day for trade and commerce. The trial period is over, and the project has been fully evaluated. Enough data was collected to see an increase in efficiency that warrants full implementation of the new logistical standard.

Now begins a process in which all shipping operations will switch to the new standard - but this process is fully automatic. The foodstuff will be delivered, the consumer goods will reach their destination, the spice will flow, and so on.

Good job!

texts.zh:
如果联邦各成员国逐利的动机微弱到这种程度，那灰暗的时代确实来临了。

由于缺乏参与及动力到了令人费解的程度，这项大有前途的物流试点变成了一场闹剧！如今还剩的只有冗长乏味的指责、官司还有诉讼了。

去请个律师吧，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]——会有些不良后果需要处理。
texts.en:
Grim times do indeed loom if this is the substandard motivation by which the federation's members pursue profit.

A baffling lack of participation and drive turned this promising logistical trial into nothing short of a farce! Now the only thing that remains is a tedious dance of blame, lawsuits and litigation.

Lawyer up, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - there will be repercussions.

texts.zh:
为了对全新的物流标准进行试点，这一恒星基地的相关设施需要进行重大的结构性改造。

指派一艘工程船到这个项目，确保项目按时完成！
texts.en:
In order to try out the new logistical standards, the relevant facilities on this starbase need to undergo some major structural alterations.

Assign a Construction Ship to the project, and make sure it's done on time!

texts.zh:
物流重构试点已经启动！但是，[From.GetName]缺少参与试点所必需的设施。一个拥有充足贸易额流经的恒星系居然没有贸易中心，真是匪夷所思。

错过有潜在好处的项目算是个错误，但连能带来巨大贸易额的顶级商业机会也会错过？这简直是犯罪！

多么耻辱，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！多么耻辱啊！
texts.en:
The logistical remodelling trial has begun! However, [From.GetName] has been found lacking in facilities necessary for participation in the trial. The lack of a Trade Hub in a system with sufficient Trade flowing through it is nothing short of baffling.

To miss out on a potentially beneficial project is a mistake, but to miss out on such a supreme business opportunity as Trade? That's almost a crime!

For shame, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! For shame!

# 即将进行的试点：物流重构 / Upcoming Trial: Logistics Remodelling

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/federations_events_1.txt:2872-3306`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:305`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 每十年（on_decade_pulse，00_on_actions.txt:305）隐藏 fedev.600：游戏进行满一年，有贸易联邦成员拥有产贸易≥100的殖民地、不在交战，且联邦没有 logistic_remodel_* 标志。
  Every decade (on_decade_pulse, 00_on_actions.txt:305) hidden fedev.600: more than one year into the game, a trade federation member has a colony producing 100+ trade, is not at war, and the federation has no logistic_remodel_* flag.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 605「即将到来的试验：物流重塑」→ 540+随机180天后 611（隐藏）：若为试验参与者 → 615「参与获批」（启用“物流重塑”项目，有离世贸易公司星港则启用离世版本，并获得 process_sharing / cost_of_progress 修正）；否则 620「参与被拒」。
  605 "Upcoming Trial: Logistics Remodelling" -> hidden 611 after 540 days (+ random 180): if a trial participant -> 615 "Trial Participation - Granted" (enables the "Logistical Remodelling" project, or the off-world version with an Offworld Trading Company starbase, with process_sharing / cost_of_progress modifiers); otherwise 620 "Participation - Denied".
- 项目成功 → 625「重塑完成」；失败 → 635「最顺滑的旅程」/640「成功的试验」/645「可悲的参与」之一，并按结果给 fully_streamlined / streamlined 物流修正或移除负面修正。
  Project success -> 625 "Remodelling Complete"; failure -> one of 635 "Smoothest of Rides" / 640 "Successful Trial" / 645 "Pathetic Participation", granting the fully_streamlined / streamlined logistics modifier or removing the penalties.
- fedev.630 在5400天后收尾（隐藏）。
  Hidden fedev.630 closes the trial after 5400 days.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 615 与 620 互斥；635/640/645 互斥。
  615 and 620 are exclusive; 635/640/645 are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 离世贸易公司星港影响项目版本。
  An Offworld Trading Company starbase changes the project variant.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发、611 衔接、项目与结果。
  Checked: trigger, the 611 link, project and outcomes.
